title: BreakWands
description:
This is a magic wand that can break blocks. Different levels of magic wands have different destruction ranges. 
一个可以破坏方块的魔法杖，不同等级魔法杖破坏范围不同。本模组全程由ai生成，作者完全不懂代码，不保证后期更新！
body:
A simple block-breaking mod. Wands made of different materials have different destruction ranges. This mod cannot replace chain mining (vein mining); it only allows breaking ordinary blocks.
一个简单的破坏方块模组，不同材质的法杖破坏范围不同。本模组不能代替连锁挖矿，只允许破坏普通方块。

Right-click on the side to break blocks horizontally, and right-click on the top to break blocks vertically. The destruction depth can be modified in the configuration file.
右键点击侧面破坏水平方向，右键点击上面破坏垂直方向，配置文件可修改破坏深度。![Six levels六种等级](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/224b20847bf42511d72ddb41a93096be1be48dd7_0.webp)![Crafting recipe合成方式](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a7cc603c7473f2eb6a7736f90ebf24b8aba733f2_0.webp)![Example示例](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0bc46a9f44409b418b08928f8d55790ebd1e5d80_0.webp)
